title: Axis 4 load anomaly detected
explanation: Axis 4 load increased above its normal operating pattern before the process interruption. Cycle time also increased during the same period.
recommendation: Inspect Axis 4 mechanical and servo condition before sustained production.

title: Cycle performance loss detected
explanation: The target cycle time is 45 seconds. During the degraded production window, actual cycle time increased and a 15-minute process fault reduced productive operating time.
recommendation: Review the Axis 4 load event and ALM-002 before increasing production rate.

title: Axis 4 inspection is overdue
explanation: Axis 4 inspection is marked overdue and is associated with repeated Axis 4 abnormal-load and fault events.
recommendation: Prioritize Axis 4 inspection before the next extended operating period.

title: Edge connection became stale
explanation: Dashboard telemetry became stale while the Edge Gateway was reconnecting. This event represents a connectivity condition rather than a robot fault.
recommendation: Check Edge Gateway network health if stale-data events become frequent.
